blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Sunday expressed regret over a Filipino’s alleged involvement in a drug trafficking scheme in Laos, saying the Philippines was committed to learning from neighboring countries’ efforts to combat the illegal drug trade. The statement followed reports that a Filipino was arrested in Laos earlier this month for allegedly attempting to smuggle 21 kilos of suspected shabu from Malaysia to the Philippines aboard a private jet booked for US$49,500, or P3.1 million. Duterte thanked the governments of Laos and Thailand for their efforts to combat drug trafficking and acknowledged the Philippines’ challenges in addressing […]...
